reason: $38 for a plain tee is more than I pay at Uniqlo or H&M, and I already have my brands that I know fit and hold up. 15% off still leaves it above what I'd normally spend, and I've never heard of Northline.
objection: I'm being asked to pay more than Uniqlo for a brand I've never heard of, online only, so I can't try it on or feel the fabric first. 'Quality fabric' is just words until I know it holds up in the wash.
would_change_my_mind: A price closer to $25 for the tee, or a friend I trust who has worn one through a lot of washes, plus an easy free return if the fit is off.
